desc: The RP63 features Rossis prized double action trigger and a crisp single action trigger pull. The RP63 is optimized for concealed carry, thanks to its 3" barrel and fixed sights. The front sight is ramped for a snag free draw. The firing pin is mounted directly to the hammer giving the gun maximum reliability with all types of primers. The RP63 has 6 shots of .357 Magnum on tap in its steel cylinder. The full underlug barrel adds additional weight which helps manage magnum recoil. Further aiding recoil control and benefiting concealment is the round butt grip frames.
